description.value: Zarak is an Afghan-Persian restaurant on Main Street in Vancouver serving refined dishes rooted in traditional family recipes, including a celebrated secret cake that has been a Sarwari family tradition for over 20 years. The restaurant describes itself as an unpretentious space where gold flakes meet mum's cooking, offering dinner, weekend brunch, and happy hour menus. Beyond dining, Zarak extends its Afghan heritage through a shop selling hand-harvested spices, traditional vests, and inspired dinnerware.
